description:
We are a trusted and adaptable IT partner with over 20 years of experience in Microsoft Cloud technologies. We are expanding our team and looking for a motivated Junior IT Support Engineer who is passionate about technology and eager to learn.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone at the beginning of their IT career to gain hands-on experience with Microsoft 365, Azure, and modern IT support practices. If you’re enthusiastic, curious, and ready to grow, we’d love to meet you!


Who We’re Looking ForGeneral Profile

We value potential and attitude over years of experience. You are:

  • Curious, proactive, and resourceful
  • Passionate about IT and eager to learn new technologies
  • Good at communicating with people
  • Organized and attentive to details
  • Motivated by solving problems and helping others
  • Good knowledge of English

Technical Profile (Nice-to-Have, Not Mandatory)

No prior IT experience is required, but any of the following are considered a plus:

  • Basic understanding of Windows operating systems
  • Basic familiarity with Microsoft 365 (Outlook, OneDrive, Teams)
  • Interest in how networks work (IP, DNS, firewalls)
  • Exposure to PowerShell or any scripting language
  • Personal projects, labs, home IT setups, or IT studies (self-taught or formal) are highly valued

Most importantly: we’re looking for someone who is passionate about IT and eager to learn.


What You’ll Do

Your responsibilities will grow as your skills grow. You will start with foundational tasks and gradually evolve toward more advanced cloud and automation work.

  • Provide first-level support to end-users
  • Troubleshoot common issues with Microsoft 365 apps, Windows devices, and networks
  • Assist senior engineers with cloud tasks such as Microsoft 365 and Azure configurations
  • Learn to automate tasks using PowerShell
  • Help maintain internal documentation
  • Continuously learn, practice, and grow your IT skills


Why Join Us?Dynamic Team

Be part of a friendly, supportive, and highly skilled team that enjoys sharing knowledge.

Growth & Training

We invest in your development:

  • Microsoft & Fortinet certification programs
  • Hands-on labs and real project exposure
  • Mentorship from experienced engineers

Great Benefits

  • Competitive salary
  • Regina Maria Premium Subscription
  • Lunch benefits
  • A clear career growth path from Junior to Senior roles


If you’re enthusiastic about starting your IT career, eager to learn Microsoft Cloud technologies, and excited by problem-solving, we’d love to hear from you!
